item.title: Summer I and III Student Course Evaluations Now Open
item.description: Date: Friday, July 31, 2026 (all day) - Summer I and III student course evaluations are now open. The evaluation period is from 7/31 through 8/15. Your feedback is very important to the Institute, the five schools, and their departments, so please complete evaluation surveys for all your courses! Evaluations will be available through Saturday, August 15, 2026.
item.author: Students

item.title: Road Closure – Peoples Avenue (Burdett Avenue to Sunset Terrace) – Friday, July 31
item.description: Please be advised that on Friday, July 31, from 4:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Peoples Avenue will be restricted to construction vehicles only between Burdett Avenue and Sunset Terrace, including access to the Houston Field House and B-Lot/D-Lot areas. Limited parking and pedestrian access to ECAV and Harkness Field will be available via E-Lot off Sunset Terrace. Please allow extra travel time and follow all posted signage and directions while work is in progress.

item.title: Fidelity Confidential Consultation (By Phone with Zoom Video Option)
item.description: Date: Tuesday, August 4, 2026 8:00 AM - 4:30 PM - Schedule a confidential consultation to help you become better informed and more confident about your workplace retirement savings plan benefits. To schedule an appointment, call 1-800-642-7131, Monday through Friday, 8:00 am to midnight, or online at https://nb.fidelity.com/public/nbpreloginnav/rpi/microsite/#/tem/meet-with-us

item.title: Help Us Enhance RPI MAX – We Want to Hear From You!
item.description:
Your feedback is important as we continue to enhance RPI MAX. If you have suggestions or feedback about the FY26 Staff Performance Review Cycle, please take a few minutes to complete the RPI MAX Feedback Form. Your input will help inform future enhancements to the RPI MAX experience.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
